newsitem.title: USA: Highlands Insurance Group Inc Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Highlands Insurance Group Inc Q4 loss.

text.p: NOTE: Q4 net premiums written: $25.9 million vs $35.7 million.
Q4 net investment income: $13.1 million vs $11.9 million.
Q4 Net realized investment gains: $278,000 vs $524,000.

1996 Q4 includes $12 million pretax charge to boost reserves for asbestos, environmental, mass tort and assumed reinsurance treaties, a $1.0 pretax charge to boost reserves for settlement of Proposition 103 and a $1.8 million reduction of net premiums earned from prior year reinsurance treaties. The company recorded an $11.7 million tax benefit associated with the charges..
Year net premiums written $135.1 million vs $201.6 million.
Year net investment income: $51.0 million vs $48.5 million.
Year net realized investment gains $1.2 million vs $2.6 million.

Gross premiums and net premiums written have been redefined for all periods presented to include the effects of changes in premiums due under retrospective policies. Such changes were previously recorded only as net premiums earned.

(b) Company was spun off from Halliburton Co January 23, 1996. Tax receipts under its intercompany tax-sharing arrangements with its former parent were recorded as additions to stockholders' equity for the periods preceding the spin off.
(c) Common stock warrants and stock options are considered to be antidilutive for primary and fully dilutive earning per share for each of the periods presented.
